summary: Small shop-backed courtyard car park; homes close on the north side.
reasons: Southern bays 40 m or more from dwellings
Bays look occupied; likely business parking

best_section.where: Southern bays of the courtyard behind West Quarter, off Army Street

drivers.seclusion: Tucked behind shops, but a mapped house sits 1 m from the north edge and homes 16 to 23 m away; the southern bays are about 15 m from the nearest of them.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane from Army Street reaches the courtyard; bays are marked and mostly filled with cars, so room for a van is tight.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side lane, but a commercial courtyard with shop and apartment activity around.
drivers.convention: Looks like private shop or resident parking; no sign of overnight stays. Loading zone signs sit at the lane mouth.

flags: Dwelling mapped 1 m from outline at 9 m
Loading zone signs on Army Street at lane mouth
sun_shade: Open to the sky mid-day; buildings shade the edges, west side and south side in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is private or signed
Gate or barrier at the lane
